collection.description: A villager who once helped teach the village children is approached by a young adult with a memory.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), who once helped teach and care for the village children, is approached by a young adult. They remember a small kindness from years ago that he has nearly forgotten. He had never realized how much an ordinary afternoon could matter.

choices.label: Tell Them He Remembers Their Effort
Reflect on the Years He Spent Helping Children

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The former child recalls how he stayed after a lesson to help them understand something difficult.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They remember him fixing a broken toy rather than scolding them for damaging it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They are moved that he noticed how hard they tried.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They admit that life has been difficult, and he offers friendship without trying to solve everything.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: He realizes that caring for a community can leave a legacy without becoming a parent himself.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: He remembers moments when he was impatient or unsure, and hopes he has grown wiser since then.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: He confuses two childhood stories, and they correct him with affectionate laughter.
